name: Alex Rivers
comment: The AI Interviewer felt surprisingly human. It picked up on my specific mentions of React Concurrent Mode and pushed me to explain the trade-offs in detail. Excellent prep for a FAANG-level loop.

name: Sarah Chen
comment: System design questions were quite challenging. The AI asked me to scale a real-time messaging app and caught my logic flaw in the database sharding strategy. Very helpful feedback after the session.

name: Marcus Thorne
comment: Tough but fair. I realized my understanding of GraphQL resolvers needs more work. The post-interview breakdown pinpointed exactly which resources I should study next. A wake-up call I needed.

name: Jasmine Wu
comment: I used the custom 'Machine Learning' module. The AI probed my knowledge of gradient vanishing problems and suggested improvements to my explanation of LSTM architectures. Superb tool.

name: David Miller
comment: The coding playground integration worked flawlessly. I wrote my solution in the browser, and the AI reviewed my time complexity live. Really helped me build confidence for technical screens.

name: Elena Rodriguez
comment: Used it to practice behavioral questions for a leadership role. The AI was surprisingly good at asking follow-ups using the STAR method. Best mock interview platform I've used so far.
